jobs.title: Hotel Security Pro — Upscale Property, Flexible Shifts
jobs.description:
United Service Companies in Santa Clara is seeking a Security Officer to join our hotel security team. This full-time position includes day, swing and blended shifts, with a focus on protecting guests, staff and property while delivering excellent customer service.

The ideal candidate has at least 2 years of public safety or upscale private security experience, strong writing skills for incident reports, and a California BSIS Guard Card or the ability to obtain one.

jobs.title: Luxury Hotel Security Officer - Guest Safety & Service
jobs.description: The Houstonian in Houston, TX, is hiring a Full Time Security professional. Responsibilities include protecting property and assets, responding to emergencies, and enforcing company policies to maintain luxury standards. The ideal candidate will have a high school diploma or equivalent, 1-4 years of security experience, and strong communication skills. Physical requirements involve frequent standing, walking, and lifting. CPR/AED certification is a plus.

jobs.description:
Thompson Hotels in Houston is seeking a dedicated Security Officer for the PM shift. This role involves ensuring the safety and security of guests and employees within a luxury hotel environment.

The ideal candidate will exhibit strong communication skills, customer service orientation, and flexibility in working hours. Join a team committed to excellence and enjoy benefits including medical insurance and paid time off.
